name: SFA30 formaldehyde sensor
description: Sensirion electrochemical formaldehyde (HCHO) sensor module, 0–1000 ppb (resolution 1 ppb, ±20 ppb or ±20 %), with an on-board Sensirion humidity and temperature sensor for compensation and output; a new averaged reading every 0.5 s. Runs on 3.15–5.5 V; I2C mode (SEL to GND) at address 0x5D, 100 kHz, external pull-ups needed. Sold as: Sensirion SFA30-D-T module (e.g. in the SEK-SFA30 evaluation kit) on its Molex Micro-Lock Plus 1.25 mm 7-pin connector wired out with jumper leads, pins VDD, GND, SDA, SCL, SEL (pins 6 and 7 are NC and left unwired).
eli5: Smells the air for formaldehyde, a harmful gas that comes out of new furniture, glues and paints, and also tells you the temperature and humidity.

pins.name: VDD
pins.description: Supply, 3.15–5.5 V (3.3 V or 5 V typical); 1–2 mA measuring, 5 mA peak

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data (pin 3, RX in UART mode). Open-drain, needs an external pull-up (10 kΩ) to the bus voltage; inputs tolerate up to 5.5 V

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock (pin 4, TX in UART mode). Open-drain, needs an external pull-up (10 kΩ) to the bus voltage

pins.name: SEL
pins.description: Interface select (pin 5): pull to GND before or at power-up for I2C; floating or VDD selects UART

buildNotes: Power VDD from 3.3 V (3.15–5.5 V allowed). The I2C levels follow the supply, so on an ESP32 or Pico run the sensor from 3.3 V and pull SDA/SCL up to 3.3 V.
SEL (connector pin 5) must be tied to GND before or at power-up to select I2C; floating or tied to VDD the module talks UART (SHDLC, 115200 baud) and never answers at 0x5D.
SDA and SCL are open-drain and need external pull-ups (10 kΩ to the bus voltage). Keep the I2C cable under 10 cm; Sensirion recommends UART for anything longer than 20 cm.
Commands are 16-bit, sent MSB first with no CRC: start 0x0006, stop 0x0104, read values 0x0327, device marking 0xD060, reset 0xD304. Wait 5 ms between the command and the read.
Read values returns 9 bytes: three signed 16-bit words each followed by a CRC-8 (poly 0x31, init 0xFF): HCHO = raw / 5 ppb, RH = raw / 100 %, T = raw / 200 °C.
The HCHO output reads 0 for the first 10 s after power-up; humidity and temperature are valid at once. Do not press on the orange or black electrochemical cell, and keep its area clear.

driver.code:
# Sensirion SFA30 formaldehyde (HCHO) sensor module, MicroPython driver (I2C mode).
# Written from "Description of the SFA30 I2C Interface" (Sensirion app note V1.0, July 2022):
# address 0x5D, 16-bit commands sent MSB first without CRC, every 2-byte data word followed by a
# CRC-8 (poly 0x31, init 0xFF), 100 kHz max, wait ~5 ms between a command and its read.
# The SEL pin must be tied to GND before (or when) the module powers up to select I2C.
import time

_START = 0x0006   # start continuous measurement (only from idle mode)
_STOP = 0x0104    # stop continuous measurement
_READ = 0x0327    # read measured values: 3 x (int16 + CRC)
_MARKING = 0xD060 # device marking string, 16 words
_RESET = 0xD304   # soft reset


def _crc8(data):
    crc = 0xFF
    for b in data:
        crc ^= b
        for _ in range(8):
            crc = ((crc << 1) ^ 0x31) & 0xFF if crc & 0x80 else (crc << 1) & 0xFF
    return crc


def _i16(hi, lo):
    v = (hi << 8) | lo
    return v - 0x10000 if v & 0x8000 else v


class SFA30:
    def __init__(self, i2c, addr=0x5D):
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr

    def _cmd(self, cmd):
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, bytes([cmd >> 8, cmd & 0xFF]))

    def _read_words(self, cmd, n_words):
        self._cmd(cmd)
        time.sleep_ms(5)  # sensor needs time to fill its read buffer
        d = self.i2c.readfrom(self.addr, n_words * 3)
        out = []
        for i in range(0, n_words * 3, 3):
            if _crc8(d[i:i + 2]) != d[i + 2]:
                raise OSError('SFA30 CRC mismatch: check wiring, pull-ups and cable length')
            out.append((d[i], d[i + 1]))
        return out

    def start(self):
        """Enter measurement mode. A new value is ready every 0.5 s; the HCHO output reads 0
        for the first 10 s after power-up."""
        self._cmd(_START)
        time.sleep_ms(600)  # no result exists for the first 0.5 s

    def stop(self):
        self._cmd(_STOP)
        time.sleep_ms(5)

    def reset(self):
        self._cmd(_RESET)
        time.sleep_ms(100)

    def read(self):
        """Return (formaldehyde in ppb, relative humidity in %RH, temperature in degC).
        Values are averages of all 0.5 s measurements since the previous read."""
        w = self._read_words(_READ, 3)
        hcho = _i16(*w[0]) / 5.0
        rh = _i16(*w[1]) / 100.0
        t = _i16(*w[2]) / 200.0
        return hcho, rh, t

    def device_marking(self):
        w = self._read_words(_MARKING, 16)
        s = bytes(b for pair in w for b in pair)
        return s.split(b'\x00')[0].decode()

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from sfa30 import SFA30

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}), freq=100000)
sensor = SFA30(i2c)
sensor.start()
while True:
    hcho, rh, t = sensor.read()
    print('HCHO=%.1f ppb RH=%.2f%% T=%.2fC' % (hcho, rh, t))
    time.sleep(1)
